prompt: What is the photon-number distribution of an ideal coherent state |α⟩?
options: Thermal with mean |α|, like blackbody light
Poisson with mean |α|²
Fixed at |α|
Gaussian in n, mean |α|
explanation: P(n) = e^(−|α|²)|α|^(2n)/n!, which is a Poisson distribution whose mean photon number is |α|².
hint: Which distribution has variance equal to the mean?
